title: BTS Confirmed for Three 2026 MTV VMA Nods, Joining Best Group Race Against BLACKPINK
detail: September 19-20, 2026 — Coverage clarified that BTS holds three nominations at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, not the two (Song of the Year, Best K-Pop) reported when nominations were first announced Aug 18: the group is also up for Best Group for 'SWIM,' a category where it seeks to reclaim a title it won four consecutive years (2019-2022) — the most of any act in the category's history. BTS and BLACKPINK, the reigning Best Group winner, anchor a K-pop-heavy field that also includes CORTIS and KATSEYE alongside FLO, Fuerza Regida, Geese and Twenty One Pilots. Fan voting runs via MTV's Instagram Stories bracket format Monday-Thursday ET ahead of the ceremony, which airs Sunday, Sept 27 from Los Angeles's Peacock Theater, hosted by Snoop Dogg.

media.caption: BTS and BLACKPINK lead the K-pop contingent in the 2026 MTV VMA Best Group race.
